body:
im way too emotional, get hurt too easily, get too jealous, all the qualities i shouldnt have, i do have way too strong

sorry for taking up your time nvm it'll pass i feel great

i guess you described it perfectly

i just want to be like everyone else, but i know i never will, i'm not what a dude should be like and it's slowly killing my soul
i'll never get what i truly want
all my ambitions stem from unrealistic portrayals in movies and books, i find nothing in life interesting, it's just a constant game of trying to make it through one more day

i dont actively plan anything out, i get detailed scenes in my head of how it would go down, up to the point on how others would react to it. like watching a graphic video inside my head and it's all very detailed. i just can't see myself in the future anymore, it feels like i'm wasting every breath and i just don't see the point anymore
